top_signals.title: Ship-Fuel Crunch Persists Despite More Oil, Vitol Says
top_signals.summary: Accelerating crude exports through the Strait of Hormuz aren’t translating into higher production of a dirty shipping fuel, according to a top Vitol Group executive, tightening supplies and sending prices soaring.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
